round1_decision.figma_layout_review: B shows modestly stronger structural title/counter-mass behavior, but neither content pair establishes a decisive integrated-design advantage and absolute commercial quality remains below target.
round1_decision.reason: Roadmap requires visible gain without serious quality problems for P4. Current outputs remain generic and template-like; proxy Figma review cannot establish final pixel quality.

single_primary_hypothesis.statement: The P3 B-arm compiler reintroduced fixed or quasi-fixed positional topology even though V1.1 defines title/photo masses and type-safe space as location-variable. This likely caused left-title/right-photo template collapse and suppressed the intended transfer freedom.
evidence: STYLE_CAPSULE_V1_1_CANDIDATE: location-variable type-safe space and movable mass relations
SHANJUN_JOINT_INPUT B: upper/right photo mass plus lower-left/lower-offset type zone with normalized target coordinates
DOUFANG_JOINT_INPUT B: lower-right/central process mass plus upper-left/transverse type zone with normalized target coordinates
Figma proxy review: both pairs converge on a familiar large-left-title plus right/central-photographic-mass topology

B_remove: all normalized x/y target coordinates for type-safe regions
mandatory upper/right, lower/right, upper-left or lower-left mass locations
placement language that preselects a screen quadrant
B_keep: no detached panel or gradient patch
no copied source identity or glyph contours
final_round_change.A_change: NONE; keep the same direct-reference brief and equal production conditions

stop_rule: If the final round still shows only marginal or inconsistent B gain, close P3 as incremental benefit not sufficient for commercial validation; do not add more visual rules or repeat rounds to chase a win.
